title: Rename activate_* tools to encode their MCP target in the name
description: R1 from codebase audit tool-discovery audit. The current activate_* tool names (e.g., activate_memorysmith_task_management) sound like app feature toggles, not tool-registration gates. Rename to activate_mcp_memorysmith_tasks, activate_mcp_pylance_diagnostics, etc. so the mcp_ prefix immediately signals "this injects MCP tools into the registry." This is a VS Code extension / MCP host code change outside this repo.
